info.prompt: A cyber-gothic neural cathedral where 20 biomechanical nodes pulse with synaptic fire—Horror and Roguelike modules loom as gargoyle-like structures wrapped in {#c8d400 chartreuse|#3388ff cerulean} circuit veins, their arches dripping {liquid code|glowing glyphs}. The background dissolves into a {floating hex grid|etched mathematical parchment}, while ASCII sigils slither across the stone like silver worms. Each connection thrums with a heartbeat LFO, casting long shadows from the Horror node's jagged spires.
